name: saudi-utils
description: Saudi Utils for validation and normalization.

scripts.clean: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'coverage']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.docs:check: npm run build && tsc --project tsconfig.examples.json --noEmit && node examples/quick-start.ts && node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs
scripts.package:check: npm run build && npm run publint && npm run attw && npm run pack:check
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
